title: The question
approved_narration_excerpt: What if I told you a Ghana Premier League club kept 24 clean sheets in 34 matches... and still didn’t win the title?
visual_intent: Open with one contradiction. The 24/34 ratio is the visual hook; conceal the club identity until the next beat.
motion_transition: 24 enters first. 34 appears second. “NO TITLE” becomes the reversal.

title: Only 15 conceded
approved_narration_excerpt: In the 2025/26 season, Hearts of Oak conceded just 15 goals throughout the entire league campaign.
visual_intent: Reveal Hearts using a clean wordmark, not an invented crest. A single large 15 establishes defensive dominance.
motion_transition: Club name slides in as 15 counts upward to its final value.

title: 24 clean sheets
approved_narration_excerpt: They kept an incredible 24 clean sheets.
visual_intent: Build a 34-tile field representing fixtures. Colour 24 gold, leave 10 subdued. Tiles are grouped by category, not match chronology.
motion_transition: 34 neutral tiles appear; first 24 fill amber in a staggered sequence.

title: The 0–0 reveal
approved_narration_excerpt: But here’s the surprising part. 13 of those clean sheets ended in goalless draws.
visual_intent: Keep the SAME 34-tile grid. Transform 13 of the 24 gold tiles into teal 0–0 tiles, without changing the viewer’s mental model.
motion_transition: Persistent tiles change state; 13 become teal 0–0. Remaining 11 clean sheets stay gold.

title: What 0–0 means
approved_narration_excerpt: Thirteen matches where their opponents couldn’t score... but neither could Hearts.
visual_intent: Hold on the actual contradiction. Show 13 goalless fixtures against 11 other clean sheets. Let the finding breathe.
motion_transition: Retain the visual grid while highlighting the 13 teal outcomes.

title: Defence ≠ attack
approved_narration_excerpt: And that’s the problem. Football isn’t just about stopping goals. You also have to score them.
visual_intent: Turn the story from defending to scoring with a typographic hinge instead of a random football graphic.
motion_transition: DEFENCE slides aside. ATTACK takes the same visual position; amber underline becomes teal.

title: Only 25 goals
approved_narration_excerpt: Hearts managed only 25 goals in 34 matches.
visual_intent: One big number followed by its denominator. Clear and unembellished.
motion_transition: 25 holds first, then /34 appears as supporting context.

title: Below league average
approved_narration_excerpt: That’s an average of just 0.74 goals per game, compared to the league average of 1.02.
visual_intent: Compare like for like: goals per team per match. Start both bars at zero; lengths use a shared scale.
motion_transition: Two bars grow from a common baseline: 0.74 / 1.02.
on_screen_summary: 0.74 vs 1.02 goals per team per game.

title: 18 scoreless matches
approved_narration_excerpt: In fact, they failed to score in 18 matches.
visual_intent: Return to the 34-tile motif. Group 18 scoreless fixtures, including the 13 earlier 0–0s, without claiming chronological match order.
motion_transition: The tile system reappears. The 18 scoreless outcomes turn teal; 16 stay subdued.

title: Enter the champions
approved_narration_excerpt: Now, compare that with the eventual champions, Medeama. Both clubs lost exactly six matches.
visual_intent: Show equal defeats. Establish that losing fewer games is not the explanation for the points difference.
motion_transition: Two identical 6-loss values land simultaneously, with a connecting equal sign.

title: The wins difference
approved_narration_excerpt: But while Medeama won 17 games, Hearts managed just 13.
visual_intent: Two accurately scaled bars: Hearts 13 wins; Medeama 17. No 3D effects or distorted scales.
motion_transition: Equal starting point; Medeama’s bar extends farther.

title: Eight points behind
approved_narration_excerpt: And that difference in wins and draws left Hearts eight points behind the champions.
visual_intent: Show both records and final points. The 8-point gap is explained as a result of four additional wins replacing draws.
motion_transition: Reveal points 54 vs 62, then a precise +8 gap annotation.

title: The takeaway
approved_narration_excerpt: Hearts had an extraordinary defence. But they couldn’t turn enough of those clean sheets into victories.
visual_intent: Return to the visual question: 24 clean sheets become 13 draws, then 54 points. A reflective, not accusatory, conclusion.
motion_transition: Gold clean-sheet quantity becomes a teal draw result, then fades into the conclusion.

title: GilB signature
approved_narration_excerpt: Unpacked by GilB. There’s more to the story.
visual_intent: End with restrained creator branding. No generic “like and subscribe” prompt.
motion_transition: Wordmark reveals with a single gold rule. Hold on tagline.
